content: BIR: any computerized system that generates invoices or keeps books of accounts must be registered as a CAS (Acknowledgement Certificate replaced PTU in 2021); EIS certification deadline Dec 31 2026 for covered taxpayers. RR 7-2024 (EOPT, effective Apr 27 2024) makes the Invoice the primary document for goods and services; ORs/acknowledgement receipts are supplementary proof of payment, not valid for input tax. Implication: CSPS must not present its order summaries as invoices/ORs.
